title: Pairs of Songs Divisible by 60
statement:
A playlist has `n` songs, and song `i` lasts `time[i]` seconds. Count the pairs of different songs `(i, j)` with `i < j` whose total duration `time[i] + time[j]` is divisible by `60` (so the pair fills a whole number of minutes).

Every pair of positions is counted separately, even if the two songs have the same duration.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
The second line contains `n` integers `time[0] ... time[n-1]`.
outputFormat: Print one integer: the number of valid pairs.

examples.explanation: The pair (45, 15) sums to 60. The three songs with remainder 30 (30, 90 and 30) give three pairs of total 60, 120 or 120. The song of length 60 has no partner with remainder 0. That makes 1 + 3 = 4 pairs.
Every duration is a multiple of 60, so every one of the C(4, 2) = 6 pairs works.
The sums 3, 4 and 5 are not divisible by 60.

hints: Only time[i] mod 60 matters: two songs pair up exactly when their remainders add up to 0 or 60.
Counting each pair directly takes O(n^2). Instead, scan once and, for each song, ask how many earlier songs have the complementary remainder (60 - r) mod 60.
Keep an array of 60 counters indexed by remainder. The answer can reach about 5 · 10^9, so use a 64-bit integer.

def gen(rng):
    def fmt(a):
        return str(len(a)) + '\n' + ' '.join(map(str, a))

    tests = [
        fmt([60]),
        fmt([30]),
        fmt([30, 30]),
        fmt([45, 15, 30, 90, 30, 60]),
        fmt([60, 120, 180, 60]),
        fmt([1, 2, 3]),
        fmt([59, 1, 61, 119, 120]),
        fmt([10**9, 10**9, 10**9 - 40]),
    ]
    for _ in range(25):
        n = rng.randint(1, 20)
        r = rng.choice([30, 60, 130, 10**9])
        tests.append(fmt([rng.randint(1, r) for _ in range(n)]))
    n = 100000
    tests.append(fmt([60 * rng.randint(1, 16000000) for _ in range(n)]))
    tests.append(fmt([rng.randint(1, 10**9) for _ in range(n)]))
    tests.append(fmt([rng.choice([30, 90, 150, 10**9 - (10**9 % 60) + 30 - 60]) for _ in range(n)]))
    tests.append(fmt([rng.randint(1, 500) for _ in range(n)]))
    tests.append(fmt([rng.choice([7, 53, 13, 47, 60]) for _ in range(n)]))
    return tests
